summary: Validation outside California is done. Madre was rebuilt and California re-measured: the 31-member p50 before GSI (pre-GSI worktree at 29f0e2d) equals docs/validation.md 5.1 to the third decimal (Eaton 0.438, Madre 0.395, Palisades 0.467, 32 leads 0.438), and after the GSI code it equals that run exactly (max |delta| 0.0 on every lead). The pre-registration (12 fires, absolute UTC starts incl. ignition + 6/12/24 h, GSI method with parameters and both inputs, replacement rule) was committed (29f0e2d) before any score outside California. GSI (NFDRS 2016 Growing Season Index, NFDRS4 defaults) is implemented for fires outside California with the backend-only sim/lfm_gsi.json, a never-silent fallback and --require-hrrr failing on a refused series; California's values and notes are unchanged (tested). All 12 fires were built with --require-hrrr (0 ERA5 and 0 GFS-filled hours each) and pass every bundle check; none was replaced. One build bug was found and fixed (catalog AOI sizing ignored WFIGS perimeters outside California; Windy Deuce's AOI clipped the fire), with a regression test and before/after values for every fire. Results (mean of fire means, 31-member p50 growth Sorensen): Northwest 0.255, Northern Rockies 0.341, Great Basin 0.247, Southwest 0.351, Southern Plains 0.394, Southeast 0.193; Southern California 0.433 (in-sample); Rocky Mountain, Eastern and Northern California untested. Outside California the model usually forecasts too little growth (8 of 12 fires); a faster multiplier helps those fires but lowers California, so nothing was adopted. GSI fixes the California table's failure on February grass (Windy Deuce 0.021 -> 0.302) and is neutral elsewhere. backend/fire3d/data/regional_accuracy.json is written by validate regional and served by /api/accuracy-regions.

14.12.10 day length: NFDRS4's own formula (CalcDayl, MT-CLIM constants, DAYSOFF 10.25); Open-Meteo daylight_duration is fetched and stored for audit only.
14.12.10 inputs: hourly temperature_2m and relative_humidity_2m aggregated to the fire's local days (Tmin, Tmax, RHmin), not Open-Meteo daily aggregates; models=era5 on the archive.
14.12.10 window: the series covers start - 28 d through the end of the bundle's weather window, so later hindcast starts use their own 21 days.
Outside California the water-year request is still made best-effort (no warning while GSI applies): it serves the never-silent fallback and the ablation.
INTERIM_LFM_NOTE text is now the 14.12.10 wording 'Live fuel moisture: California's seasonal values (GSI series unavailable); experimental.' (wave 1 said 'regional method not tested yet').
Herb treated as perennial (no NFDRS4 annual curing state), no snow-day flag (pre-registered).
fuel_groups_tested is computed from the LANDFIRE FBFM40 families of each fire's burned area (words grass/shrub/timber with >= 25 %); OSCC now reads grass, shrub (the seed said chaparral, grass).

notes_for_integrator:
SPEC 8.4 (not validation's file): replace the interim bullet with the GSI paragraph:
SPEC §8.4, replace the bullet "Outside California these California values are used as an interim ..." with:
  - Outside California (`summary.state != "CA"`) live fuel moisture follows the NFDRS 2016 Growing Season Index
    (Jolly et al. 2005; the default parameters of the USFS reference code NFDRS4): daily GSI = iTmin · iVPD · iDayl
    with iTmin 0 at −2 °C .. 1 at 5 °C (daily minimum temperature), iVPD 1 at 900 Pa .. 0 at 4100 Pa (VPD =
    es(Tmax) · (1 − max(RHmin, 5 %)/100), es = 610.7 · exp(17.38 T / (239 + T)) Pa), iDayl 0 at 10 h .. 1 at 11 h (MT-CLIM
    day length); the GSI at a forecast start is the mean of the 21 local days before the start's day (all 21 required),
    scaled by MaxGSI 1.0; below the green-up threshold 0.5 herb 0.30 and woody 0.60, above it linear to herb 2.50 and
    woody 2.00 at GSI 1. Inputs: hourly 2 m temperature and humidity at the fire, aggregated to the fire's local days,
    from the Open-Meteo ERA5 archive (`models=era5`, historical builds: start − 28 d through the end of the weather
    window) or the forecast host's `past_days=28` (live builds); stored in the backend-only `sim/lfm_gsi.json`
    (builds and live forecasts fetch it; hindcasts never do). The hourly fire behaviour charts use each local day's
    GSI and hold the latest 21-day value after the series ends (a live series ends today). The forecast note reads "live fuel moisture herb H%, woody W%: NFDRS 2016 growing season
    index G (mean of the 21 days A..B; source)". `config.GSI_*`. California keeps the month table and drought rule.
  - Never silent: a bundle outside California without the series (refused or failed request, or fewer than 21 days
    before a start) uses California's values with the manifest warning "Live fuel moisture outside California uses
    California's seasonal values until a regional method is tested; experimental." and the forecast note prefix "Live
    fuel moisture: California's seasonal values (GSI series unavailable); experimental."; hours of the behaviour charts
    without a GSI value add the manifest warning "Fire behaviour charts (<dates>, <n> h): live fuel moisture uses
    California's seasonal values (GSI series unavailable); experimental."; `build --require-hrrr` fails
    instead. docs/validation.md section 10 reports the method's test on 12 fires.
